title: Benchmarking System One Models for Time-Series Decision Making: A Case Study of Jev
abstract: arXiv:2610.33410v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series tasks require both accurate predictions and fast decisions. Advances in large models have introduced decision-oriented models that directly output answers and their probabilities, which we call Structured System 1 models. Their applicability to time-series tasks remains underexplored. Using Jev 1.13.0 as a case study, we evaluate time-series classification, event type prediction, oil temperature direction and stock movement prediction, converting continuous forecasting targets into discrete decisions to fit the model interface. We establish a unified evaluation framework using accuracy and AUC. Results show stronger performance on selected explicit temporal patterns and event type prediction, but near-chance discrimination on many numerical sequence classification tasks and stock movement prediction. translated_title: 面向时间序列决策的系统一模型基准测试：以Jev为例
translated_abstract: 时间序列任务既需要准确的预测，也需要快速的决策。大模型的最新进展催生了直接输出答案及其概率的决策导向模型，我们将其称为“结构化系统一”模型。这类模型在时间序列任务上的适用性尚未得到充分探索。本文以Jev 1.13.0为案例，评估了时间序列分类、事件类型预测、油温方向预测和股票走势预测，并将连续预测目标转换为离散决策以适配模型接口。我们建立了基于准确率和AUC的统一评估框架。结果显示，该模型在部分显式时间模式和事件类型预测任务上表现较强，但在许多数值序列分类任务和股票走势预测上的判别能力仅接近随机水平。一些数据集还揭示了排序质量与最终决策准确率之间的差距。这些发现促使对该模型在时间序列决策方面的改进。
tldr: 本文以Jev 1.13.0为案例，首次系统评估了“结构化系统一”类大模型在时间序列决策任务中的表现，建立了统一的准确率与AUC评估框架，发现该类模型仅在显式时间模式和事件类型预测上表现较好，而在数值序列分类和股票走势预测上接近随机水平。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic benchmark of Structured System 1 models for time-series decision making using Jev 1.13.0 as a case study, establishing a unified accuracy/AUC evaluation framework and showing strong performance on explicit temporal patterns and event type prediction, but near-chance performance on numerical sequence classification and stock movement prediction.
